c676839d455f6fe8.description: تنفيذ عمليات تحصيل قيمة مبيعات المنتجات من العملاء عبر وسائل الدفع المعتمدة، بما في ذلك النقد، وبطاقات فيزا ومدى، وخدمات التقسيط مثل تابي وتمارا وغيرها، مع إعادة المبالغ المتبقية للعملاء عند السداد النقدي. إصدار فواتير المبيعات وتسليمها للعملاء، وإبلاغهم بسياسة الإرجاع والاستبدال المعتمدة لدى الشركة. المشاركة في وضع المنتجات داخل الأكياس وتسليمها للعملاء. جرد الإيرادات النقدية في الصندوق ومطابقتها مع تقرير المبيعات اليومي، تحت إشراف مسؤول أول عمليات المعرض. التحقق بشكل يومي من سلامة أجهزة نظام احتساب المشتريات والماسح الضوئي للمنتجات، ومطابقة المبالغ الموجودة في الصندوق عند استلامه، والتأكد من جاهزية الأدوات والمعدات ذات الصلة.

c62f876b220ad983.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الحلول السعودية الذكية عن مهندس مدني للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية الإشراف على المشاريع الإنشائية من مرحلة الدراسة الأولية وحتى التنفيذ، مع ضمان مطابقة جميع الأعمال للمواصفات والمعايير الهندسية. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 5 و10 سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة طبوغرافية وجيولوجية الموقع الإنشائي وتحليل نتائج اختبار فحص التربة. دراسة المتطلبات والمخططات المعمارية للمشروع لتحديد الجدوى الإنشائية. تحديد أعماق التأسيس اللازمة للمشروع وإجراء تحليل إنشائي متكامل لعناصره. إعداد التصاميم الإنشائية للمشروع ومتابعة إعداد المخططات الإنشائية وتدقيقها. تدقيق جداول الكميات والمواصفات للمواد الإنشائية. الإشراف المباشر على تنفيذ المشروع ومطابقة جميع الأعمال للمواصفات الفنية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في مجال الهندسة المدنية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسبة تقدمها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة شهادة جامعية في الهندسة المدنية. خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال الهندسة الإنشائية أو الإشراف على المشاريع. معرفة قوية بأسس التصميم الإنشائي وتحليل التربة. القدرة على قراءة وتدقيق المخططات الهندسية وجداول الكميات. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات ممتازة في الإشراف على المشاريع وإدارة الجودة. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية والوثائق المتخصصة. مهارات تواصل فعالة والقدرة على العمل ضمن فريق. الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة في بيئة العمل. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، وهو دور بدوام كامل ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة الحلول السعودية الذكية. يتطلب الدور التزامًا بالإشراف الميداني على المشاريع لضمان سير العمل وفقًا للمواصفات والمعايير. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهندسين المدنيين المؤهلين وذوي الخبرة لتقديم طلباتهم لهذا الدور في الرياض.

c6979d1b6d5ad903.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سماك للخدمات الطبية عن طبيب أسنان عام للانضمام إلى فريقها في بيشة، بمنطقة عسير. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال طب الأسنان. سيقوم شاغل الوظيفة بتشخيص أمراض الفم والأسنان، وإعداد الخطط العلاجية، وإجراء المعالجات السنية المختلفة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء الفحص الشامل لأسنان المرضى، وتحديد الصور الشعاعية اللازمة وتحليلها لتشخيص حالات الفم والأسنان، ثم وضع خطة علاجية وجدول زمني لها. تجهيز وتطبيق الحشوات، ومعالجة القنوات اللبية للأسنان، وتنظيف الأسنان وإزالة الرواسب الكلسية. تحديد احتياجات المريض من التعويضات السنية، وأخذ القياسات اللازمة، ومتابعة تنفيذها وتركيبها وضبطها. فحص اللثة وتشخيص أمراضها، ومعالجة التهابات اللثة، وإجراء جراحات الفم الصغرى. وصف العلاجات والأدوية المناسبة للمرضى. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات في مجال طب الأسنان. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير الطبية المتعلقة بأعمال طب الأسنان وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة، مع ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال طب الأسنان العام. القدرة على تشخيص أمراض الفم والأسنان بدقة. مهارة في إجراء المعالجات السنية المختلفة وجراحات الفم الصغرى. الالتزام بتطبيق معايير السلامة العامة في بيئة العمل. بيئة العمل يعمل طبيب الأسنان العام ضمن فريق شركة سماك للخدمات الطبية في بيشة، عسير. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التزاماً بتقديم رعاية صحية عالية الجودة للمرضى. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريقنا، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم عبر القنوات المتاحة.

c6a9da053639da12.description: About the Role Savills is seeking a Planner to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves developing, maintaining, and interrogating integrated project programs to ensure reliable progress measurement, accurate forecasting, and thorough schedule risk analysis. The Planner will play a key role in supporting proactive decision-making by identifying critical-path issues, interface constraints, and necessary recovery actions across multiple work packages. Key Responsibilities Review contractor baseline and revised programs for logic, sequencing, resource loading, calendars, milestones, and contractual compliance. Develop and maintain the consultant’s integrated master schedule and package-level reporting structure. Update progress using verified site data and assess planned versus actual performance, critical path, and float movement. Prepare weekly and monthly schedule reports, dashboards, S-curves, look-ahead schedules, and milestone forecasts. Identify delays, constraints, and program risks; quantify potential impacts and recommend mitigation or recovery actions. Review recovery programs, acceleration proposals, time-impact analyses, and extension-of-time submissions. Coordinate with engineering, procurement, construction, testing, and commissioning teams to validate interfaces and dependencies. Maintain schedule narratives, assumptions, change logs, progress measurement rules, and auditable records. Support earned value analysis, cash-flow forecasting, and alignment between program, cost, and resource information. Facilitate planning workshops and communicate schedule priorities and required decisions clearly to stakeholders. Required Experience Candidates should possess 7-10 years of experience in a relevant planning role, demonstrating a strong understanding of project programming and schedule management. Work Environment and Location This is a full-time position based in Riyadh. The role requires collaboration with various project teams and stakeholders to ensure project timelines and objectives are met effectively.

c6cf8f0bfab8a3ee.description: About the Role Tamara is seeking a Compliance Senior Associate to join its team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves supporting the Compliance Department in ensuring adherence to SAMA regulations applicable to payment services, including activities under the Electronic Money Institution (EMI) license and other Payment Service Provider (PSP) categories. The position requires 2-5 years of experience in a relevant compliance function. Role Overview The Compliance Senior Associate will be responsible for both advisory and monitoring functions to ensure ongoing regulatory compliance. This includes reviewing products and processes, interpreting regulatory updates, and preparing reports for SAMA. The ideal candidate will be a driven and solution-oriented team player, capable of adapting quickly to changing circumstances while maintaining focus and energy. Key Responsibilities Ensure compliance with all applicable SAMA regulations related to payment services, including EMI, PSP, and wallet providers. Review and approve new products to ensure alignment with SAMA requirements. Monitor internal processes and product structures for regulatory adherence. Track, interpret, and implement changes from SAMA circulars and regulatory updates. Review and maintain internal policies and procedures to ensure consistency with current SAMA regulations. Ensure proper dissemination of all circulars and publications issued by SAMA and follow up with relevant departments for timely implementation. Prepare and submit accurate regulatory reports to SAMA within required timelines. Review management reports submitted to SAMA for accuracy and completeness. Coordinate with internal teams to collect and validate data required by SAMA. Support regulatory inspections, audits, and remediation actions as needed. Provide advisory support to internal stakeholders on payment-related compliance matters. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Law, Business, Finance, or a related field. Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in a compliance role at a SAMA-regulated entity operating in the payments sector. Solid understanding of SAMA’s regulatory framework for payment services. Experience in regulatory reporting and policy review. Required Skills Strong communication, coordination, and analytical skills. Detail-oriented with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively. Ability to work effectively with diverse teams through empathy and respect. Capable of responding quickly and adapting to changes without losing momentum. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh. The role operates within a dynamic team environment where collective strength and a positive, solution-oriented outlook are valued.

c60853fa3c8b6791.description: About Ewan Development Ewan Development focuses on developing real estate and hospitality investment opportunities across the Kingdom and the wider region. The company is seeking a Marketing Manager to join its team in Makkah, with operations spanning Jeddah and Makkah. Role Summary The Marketing Manager will be responsible for leading the marketing strategy for real estate projects, from pre-launch through to sales. This full-time role requires a creative and highly organized professional who can develop compelling narratives for projects and campaigns. Key Responsibilities Lead the marketing strategy for real estate projects, covering all phases from pre-launch to sales. Develop clear creative concepts for each project and campaign, defining the idea, tone, and visual direction, and ensure content consistency. Plan and produce social media content for platforms including LinkedIn, Instagram, X, TikTok, and Snapchat, utilizing a structured content calendar. Write and brief high-quality posts, captions, and campaign messages in both Arabic and English. Collaborate with designers, photographers, videographers, and agencies, managing briefs, timelines, and approvals. Prepare marketing materials such as brochures, project presentations, and launch campaigns. Track performance, analyze results, and continuously work to improve reach, engagement, and lead generation. Support the sales team by developing campaigns designed to generate qualified leads. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in marketing, preferably within the real estate or hospitality sectors. Demonstrated ability to develop and execute comprehensive marketing strategies. Proficiency in creating content for various social media platforms. Strong writing skills in both Arabic and English for marketing communications. Work Environment and Opportunities The successful candidate will work on real estate and hospitality projects within a fast-moving environment. This role offers the opportunity to influence brand and creative direction, with good ideas being implemented efficiently. Application Process Ewan Development invites qualified candidates to apply for this full-time Marketing Manager position. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

c6254237dde44986.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث الشركة العالميه لتسويق مستلزمات النوم عن أخصائي مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تطوير سياسات البيع، متابعة تنفيذها، وتقييم النتائج لضمان تحقيق الأهداف المحددة. يتضمن العمل إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة المتعلقة بالمبيعات وعرضها وحفظها. المسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة ومتابعة تطورات السوق لتحديد وتطوير الأهداف التسويقية وطرق البيع. تقدير حجم المبيعات المتوقع وترجمة الأهداف إلى خطط بيعية قابلة للتنفيذ. اقتراح سياسات البيع ومتابعة تنفيذها، بالإضافة إلى وضع وتقييم البرامج الترويجية. التواصل الفعال مع الزبائن لتحديد مشكلاتهم ومتابعة المنافسين وبرامجهم البيعية لتجنب المخاطر المستقبلية. تقييم نتائج أداء مندوبي البيع ومدى تحقيق الأهداف البيعية، واقتراح الخطط والإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالمبيعات، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تحليل بيانات السوق وتحديد الفرص. مهارات تواصل ممتازة وبناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق المهنية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. سيعمل أخصائي المبيعات ضمن فريق مبيعات ديناميكي لدعم أهداف الشركة وتحقيق النمو. ملخص الدور يقوم أخصائي المبيعات بوضع وتنفيذ ومتابعة سياسات البيع، وتقييم الأداء، وإعداد التقارير لضمان تحقيق الأهداف البيعية للشركة العالميه لتسويق مستلزمات النوم في الرياض. يتطلب الدور مهارات تحليلية وتواصل قوية، مع خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل الموقع: الرياض الراتب: لم يتم الإفصاح عنه

c6ef368f9315a24d.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة منار العمران للتجارة والصناعة عن مهندس إنتاج للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور على تخطيط وتنسيق أنشطة وإجراءات الإنتاج في الموقع الصناعي، مع التركيز على تحسين الكفاءة والجودة. هذه فرصة بدوام كامل للمرشحين ذوي الخبرة الحديثة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد خطط وبرامج الإنتاج وتنظيم تسلسل عمليات التشغيل، مع تحديد كمية الإنتاج ونوعيته. ضمان جودة العمليات ومطابقة مواصفات المنتج للمعايير المطلوبة. متابعة وتطوير تقنيات الإنتاج من خلال إدخال طرق وخطوط إنتاج ومعدات جديدة لتحسين الكفاءة وزيادة المخرجات. دراسة معوقات الإنتاج القائمة واقتراح الحلول المناسبة لمعالجتها. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية لآلات ومعدات المصنع، بالالتزام بتعليمات الشركة المصنعة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في مجال الإنتاج. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، بما في ذلك نسب التقدم، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال هندسة الإنتاج أو ما يعادله. القدرة على تخطيط وتنسيق أنشطة الإنتاج بفعالية. مهارات جيدة في إعداد التقارير الفنية والوثائق المتخصصة. بيئة العمل يعمل مهندس الإنتاج بدوام كامل ضمن بيئة صناعية في المنطقة الشرقية، حيث يساهم في تحقيق أهداف الإنتاج للشركة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة، ولن يتم الإفصاح عنه مسبقًا.

c61003a4b9d0597d.description: About Namaa Partners Namaa Partners is a strategic consulting firm working primarily with organizations in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and companies with significant interests there. We address issues that do not fit the large firm model: a board reviewing a succession matter, a family group considering bringing in an external investor, or a holding company needing to rethink its portfolio economics. Our work covers corporate strategy, growth, market entry, operating models, efficiency, organization, talent, digital strategy, performance improvement, governance, and risk. We take on a limited number of assignments at a time, and the partners who define the scope of work also oversee its execution. We form an opinion and defend it before the client. Frequently, the assignment continues beyond the recommendation phase, with partners attending board meetings and testing management plans during implementation. Our clients include a range of established institutions in the Kingdom. About the Job This role is for a Human Resources Specialist, created because we need someone to handle the administrative side of talent within the firm in an organized manner: recruitment, contracts, social insurance, team files, and following up on group-related organization and talent matters in assignments. From day one, you will be responsible for the accuracy of these files and meeting deadlines, and you will be the first to review team data before it reaches the responsible partner. You will work closely with the partners, hearing how an assignment scope is built and how work is distributed, and you will then translate that into clear processes for recruitment, evaluation, and leave. Tasks and Responsibilities Follow up on the recruitment process from posting the advertisement to the first interview and scheduling appointments with candidates, while keeping every candidate informed of their status. Prepare and maintain employee files, contracts, and official documents, ensuring that every file is complete and easily accessible when needed. Follow up on social insurance, medical insurance, and regulatory updates within the specified deadlines. Record attendance, leave, and secondments in a clear log, and submit a monthly summary to the Finance Officer. Coordinate interviews, performance evaluation sessions, and onboarding sessions for new employees, and prepare the necessary papers and information for each session. Prepare candidate lists and talent reports requested by assignment teams when studying a client's organization and talent. Answer team questions about policies and procedures, and refer matters requiring a decision to the relevant partner. Required Qualifications Basic knowledge of HR work, through studies, training, or previous work in any organization, including the recruitment cycle, employee files, and contracts. Proficiency in using office tools, especially Excel, for building tables, organizing data, and tracking schedules. Proficiency in the Arabic language, both written and spoken, with the ability to draft clear internal correspondence. Attention to detail and commitment to regulatory deadlines, as a delay in one procedure results in liability for the firm. Clear communication with candidates, employees, and partners, while maintaining confidentiality regarding team data. Organized work approach, with the ability to prioritize when multiple tasks overlap on the same day. Willingness to learn: We do not expect you to know everything about regulations in the first month, but we do expect you to ask questions and document what you learn. Preferred Qualifications A certificate or course in Human Resources or Business Administration. Familiarity with labor and social insurance regulations in the Kingdom. Knowledge of applicant tracking systems (ATS) or any software for managing employee files. Ability to work in English, both reading and writing. What We Offer The position is permanent and full-time, based in Riyadh. Work is hybrid between the office and off-site, as agreed upon with the team. You will have the opportunity to work directly with the partners and learn how assignments are built and how their client obligations are managed. You will work on the team's entire file, not just a portion of it, and see the impact of your work in respected deadlines and reliable data. We review performance with you in your first weeks, not just once a year, and we expect your responsibilities to grow as you learn. How We Work Partners define the scope of the assignment and oversee its execution, and team issues reach them directly. Regarding HR, you are the one who holds the file and knows its status, escalating matters that require a decision to the responsible partner before a step is delayed by a pending question. We document everything: hiring decisions, file changes, and regulatory deadlines, because relying on memory in these matters does not work. We clarify what we know and what we do not know when asked for an opinion on an organizational issue. Who Succeeds in This Role A successful person here is someone who likes their paperwork to be organized and knows the status of each file without needing to open the computer. Someone who writes clear, concise messages, follows up with a candidate or employee until the matter is resolved, and never lets a regulatory deadline pass. They take responsibility for their mistakes and correct them, and maintain the privacy of what they read in team files. Most importantly, they have a genuine willingness to understand the firm's way of working, because the foundation of HR here is understanding the nature of the work we sell, not just memorizing procedures.

c630e039307737c9.description: The successful candidate will assist in developing architectural and interior design concepts, translating project requirements into functional, practical, and visually appealing spaces. The role involves preparing architectural drawings, reviewing design plans, and ensuring that proposed designs meet project objectives, client requirements, applicable building codes, and relevant technical standards before implementation. Key Responsibilities: Assist in developing architectural concepts and design proposals for various projects. Prepare and update architectural drawings, layouts, and design documentation. Support interior and exterior design activities while balancing aesthetics and functionality. Review architectural plans to ensure alignment with project requirements and design specifications. Coordinate with civil, mechanical, and electrical engineering teams to ensure design compatibility. Assist in selecting suitable materials, finishes, and design solutions. Ensure that architectural drawings comply with applicable building regulations and project standards. Participate in design reviews and occasional site visits when required. Support the preparation of presentations, reports, and project documentation. Bachelor's degree in Architecture. Fresh graduate with no previous work experience required. Must not be currently employed. Basic knowledge of architectural design principles, building materials, and construction methods. Familiarity with architectural design software such as AutoCAD, Revit, or similar tools. Strong creativity, attention to detail, communication, and teamwork skills. Willingness to learn and develop professional design and technical skill.

c6399d89b6c2f5ea.description: About the Role Tata Consultancy Services is seeking a Senior Software Engineer – AI & Cloud Applications (GCP) to join their team in Dhahran, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is a foundational hire aimed at building the organization's internal software engineering capabilities, transitioning from vendor-led development to internally owned digital products. The role involves leading the development, integration, and enhancement of enterprise software and AI-powered applications across various functions. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, test, and maintain enterprise applications, digital products, APIs, and backend services. Build end-to-end applications, including backend, frontend, database, and system integrations. Develop and integrate AI-powered capabilities, such as LLM applications, AI agents, and intelligent automation. Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and production-ready solutions. Support digital product development across trading, risk management, operations, finance, and corporate functions. Review, assess, and take ownership of source code and applications developed by external vendors. Lead technical knowledge transfer, code handovers, and transition of vendor-developed solutions to internal ownership. Evaluate code quality, architecture, security, maintainability, and technical documentation. Develop, deploy, and maintain applications on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Implement and manage CI/CD pipelines, version control, automated testing, and release processes. Help establish internal software development practices, coding standards, documentation, and technical architecture. Required Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. 10+ years of hands-on software development experience, including delivering production applications. Strong proficiency in Python and backend development frameworks such as FastAPI or Django. Experience in frontend development using React, TypeScript, JavaScript, or equivalent technologies. Strong understanding of software architecture, REST APIs, databases (SQL/NoSQL), application integration, and security. Hands-on experience with GCP services, particularly Cloud Run, Cloud Build, Cloud Storage, and related application development services. Experience with Git, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and application deployment. Demonstrated ability to independently design, develop, troubleshoot, and maintain production-grade applications. Experience working with third-party developers, reviewing code, or taking ownership of externally developed software. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Vertex AI, Gemini APIs, LLM applications, RAG architectures, and AI agents. Familiarity with Terraform, Kubernetes, and Infrastructure as Code. Remove, disassemble, repair, rig, rework, reassemble, install, modify, adjust, test and preserve power plant systems, transmission systems, tail drive shaft assembly, rotor systems, fuel cells, flight controls, subsystems, and components according to directives, technical manuals, and safety procedures. Perform inspection, troubleshooting, fault detection, fault isolation, and appropriate AVUM/AVIM corrective actions on the power plant related systems, transmission systems, tail drive shaft assembly, rotor system, fuel systems, and oil systems. Perform depot-level maintenance and repair when authorized. Perform power plant depot-level maintenance and repair when authorized. Operate and maintain all applicable peculiar and common ground support equipment. Identify, use and maintain all common, special, and precision tools available for power plant maintenance and repair. Responsible for completion and maintenance of applicable forms, records, and reports using appropriate references and other publications including the NAMP. Provide On-the-Job-Training (OJT) for Saudi technicians and/or other personnel to include maintaining appropriate records on personnel such as Readiness Insight, ASMi, or an ASMi substitute. Assist in shop safety as well as safety in the hangar and on the flight line. Accept accountability of property for the Power Plant Shop. Maintain cleanliness and general maintenance of the associated work area. Perform cleaning, preservation, and operational maintenance work on assigned vehicles, tools, and equipment. Operate motor vehicles, machines, and other mechanical equipment in the performance of assigned duties. Desired Candidate Profile Minimum Position Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Required: 8 years current or previous experience performing complex helicopter mechanical work, and verifiable experience maintaining H-60 aircraft. A valid A&P license , QAR, CDQAR, or TI qualification is required. High School Diploma or equivalent Clearance Requirement: Must be able to obtain and maintain a NAC(T3) Background Investigation and drug test. Must be able to obtain and maintain facility credentials/authorization. May be required to obtain and maintain a secret clearance. We maintain a drug-free workplace and perform post offer, pre-employment substance abuse testing.

This full-time role reports directly to the Director of Human Resources and is responsible for ensuring a safe, clean, and compliant living environment for employees. Complete clearance procedures upon staff check-out and report to Human Resources for follow-up. Conduct daily inspections of dormitory public areas and staff rooms to ensure cleanliness and address issues promptly. Schedule and coordinate regular dormitory cleanliness inspections and pest control services with contractors. Implement and enforce dormitory rules, regulations, and visitor policies. Report disciplinary issues to the Director of Human Resources and provide employee education as needed. Maintain accurate records of room key copies, fire equipment checks, and electrical facility inspections. Collaborate with the hotel's Loss Prevention Director to organize regular dormitory fire drills. Monitor dormitory contract terms, reporting and following up on any deviations. Complete and submit the dormitory staff duty roster for approval according to schedule. Maintain records of dormitory issues, including maintenance requests, special staff requests, and check-in/out details. Update and submit the rooming list to Human Resources weekly. Assist the Director of Human Resources with the linen purchase/replacement plan and coordinate weekly linen changes with laundry services. c60b6ca008777714.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ابناء معتوق حبيب البلادي مقاولات عن مهندس ضبط وتحكم في الجودة للانضمام إلى فريقها في المبرز، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة وتطوير معايير وعمليات الجودة للمشاريع الهندسية، بالإضافة إلى مراقبة وتحليل عملية التنفيذ لضمان أعلى مستويات الجودة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تصميم معايير الجودة المحددة للمشروعات الهندسية والإشراف على تطبيقها الفعال. إعداد تقارير دورية وشاملة حول أداء المشاريع الحالية والمراحل الهامة القادمة. مقارنة التقدم المخطط له في سير العمل مع التقدم الفعلي، وتحليل أي ثغرات وتوضيح المخاطر المحتملة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل بشكل مستمر ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في مجال الجودة الهندسية. إعداد وتوثيق التقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، بما في ذلك نسب التقدم، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال ضبط وتحكم الجودة، ويفضل أن تكون في المشاريع الهندسية. فهم عميق لمعايير وعمليات الجودة وتطويرها. القدرة على تحليل البيانات وتقديم تقارير واضحة ومفصلة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية لتحديد الثغرات والمخاطر. القدرة على تطوير وتحسين الإجراءات والأساليب. مهارات تواصل ممتازة لإعداد وعرض التقارير. الالتزام بالدقة والجودة في جميع جوانب العمل. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في المبرز، المنطقة الشرقية. ستعمل ضمن فريق متخصص يركز على تحقيق أعلى معايير الجودة في المشاريع الهندسية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. ندعو المهندسين المؤهلين الذين يتمتعون بالخبرة المطلوبة للتقدم لهذه الفرصة.

c6880c1f379dc18a.job_title: Senior Construction Manager (Infra & Landscape) Saudi National
c6880c1f379dc18a.description: About Parsons Corporation Parsons Corporation is seeking a Senior Construction Manager to join their team in Tabūk, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role supports a Project Management and Construction Management Consultant Services package in Sharma, focusing on construction delivery for residential complexes. Role Overview The Senior Construction Manager will oversee the construction of two residential complexes. This includes managing the delivery of villas, guest and staff villas, gates, boundary walls, and extensive associated works. The scope also covers demolition, reinstatement, earthworks, drainage, utility diversions, decommissioning, hardscape, softscape, irrigation, and landscaping. Key Responsibilities Manage and supervise construction activities across residential buildings, infrastructure, landscaping, and external works. Ensure construction adheres to approved drawings, specifications, contracts, schedules, quality standards, and safety requirements. Lead and coordinate contractors, subcontractors, consultants, site supervision teams, and project stakeholders. This role involves applying expertise in training management to a rail project, specifically ensuring the successful delivery of the ISR training package for the Riyadh Metro Line 2 (Red Line) extension. The Training Manager will define the training strategy, manage the Transfer of Technology (ToT) process, and coordinate training activities. Key Responsibilities Define a contract-compliant training strategy that incorporates Transfer of Technology (ToT) requirements. Conduct training needs assessments and create tailored training plans. Forecast and organize required facilities, materials, and digital equipment. Coordinate the preparation, production, and distribution of training documents and materials. Evaluate trainees, confirm qualifications, and maintain accurate training records. Build, update, and manage the training schedule. Monitor compliance with contractual, safety, quality, and project requirements. Identify risks and implement mitigation and recovery actions. Track training costs and resource utilization against the approved budget. Collect feedback and analyze training performance to drive continuous improvement. Ability to work with various stakeholders including customers, consortium partners, and project teams. c697695e59c8abe3.description: About Bouygues Travaux Publics Bouygues Travaux Publics KSA specializes in civil engineering, underground tunneling, and complex structures. c698cdd99ebc424f.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مولى الدويله للتجارة عن مصور فوتوغرافي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تجهيز معدات التصوير والتقاط الصور للمناظر الطبيعية والأشخاص والفعاليات، بالإضافة إلى معالجة الصور وإعداد التقارير. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تجهيز كاميرات التصوير الفوتوغرافي والرقمي. دراسة موضوع الصورة وتحليل موقع وظروف التقاطها. اختيار الكاميرا المناسبة وضبط عوامل التصوير مثل المسافة وفتحة العدسة واتجاه وزاوية التصوير. تصوير المناظر الطبيعية والأشخاص والأحداث والمناسبات المختلفة. تحميض وتظهير الصور الفوتوغرافية. معالجة الصور الرقمية باستخدام الحاسب الآلي وطباعتها. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل دوري. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التصوير الفوتوغرافي. القدرة على استخدام مختلف أنواع كاميرات التصوير الفوتوغرافي والرقمي. معرفة بأساسيات التصوير الفوتوغرافي الرقمي والتقليدي. مهارات جيدة في معالجة الصور باستخدام برامج الحاسب الآلي. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض. سيعمل المصور ضمن فريق لدعم احتياجات الشركة في مجال التصوير. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال عملية المقابلة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم.

c6a52dc526b75627.job_title: Business Development Manager / KAM New Business
c6a52dc526b75627.description: About the Role Groupe SEB is seeking a Business Development Manager / KAM – New Business to drive growth in the Saudi market. This full-time position is based in Makkah, with responsibilities covering Jeddah and Makkah. The role focuses on identifying, developing, and onboarding new business opportunities to expand the company's market presence. Key Responsibilities Identify and develop new business opportunities across relevant channels, customers, and market segments. Establish strong commercial relationships with potential customers and decision-makers. Lead negotiations to convert opportunities into profitable business and develop long-term relationships with newly acquired customers. Develop and execute business development plans to achieve sales and profitability targets. Monitor customer profitability and manage commercial risks, including payment terms and credit exposure. Expand Groupe SEB's presence in SDA and Cookware categories by identifying new channels and business models. Work closely with cross-functional teams including Marketing, Supply Chain, Finance, and Customer Service to ensure successful customer development. Monitor sales performance, profitability, and business pipeline, preparing regular reports on opportunities and risks. Ensure timely delivery of products and services and effectively resolve customer issues. c6b2c7cfb25c1977.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة جمعية أم القرى الخيرية النسائية بمكة المكرمة عن أخصائي علاقات عامة للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى مراجعة وتطوير سياسات العلاقات العامة، وتنفيذ خطط التواصل مع القطاعات المستهدفة، وتحسين الصورة الذهنية للمؤسسة لدى الجمهور. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة ومراجعة سياسة العلاقات العامة للمؤسسة وتقييم أثرها، واقتراح سبل تطويرها. تأسيس وبناء قنوات اتصال فعالة مع العملاء والشركاء الداخليين والخارجيين لتعزيز صورة المؤسسة وسمعتها وزيادة فاعلية عملياتها. متابعة التحضيرات اللازمة لاستقبال الوفود الرسمية وكبار الزوار، وتأمين احتياجاتهم خلال الزيارة، والتنسيق مع الإدارات المعنية لتنظيم جولات ميدانية تعريفية. بناء علاقات عمل مهنية وبناءة مع الجهات الخارجية والمؤسسات والشركات التابعة، وتقييم آثار هذه العلاقات. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة في مجال العلاقات العامة، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال العلاقات العامة أو ما يعادله. القدرة على تطوير وتنفيذ خطط التواصل الاستراتيجية. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل الشفهي والكتابي. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات تنظيمية عالية والقدرة على إدارة الفعاليات واستقبال الوفود. القدرة على بناء علاقات مهنية قوية والحفاظ عليها. مهارة إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة بدقة ووضوح. الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة في العمل. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مكة المكرمة، وتتطلب الوظيفة التزاماً بدوام كامل ضمن فريق عمل المؤسسة. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

c6106b9e689e7ebb.description: About the Role Site is seeking a Digital Forensics & Incident Response (DFIR) Analyst to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is responsible for investigating cybersecurity incidents, performing digital forensic investigations, and supporting enterprise incident response activities. The position focuses on protecting the organization's critical assets through expertise in Digital Forensics, Incident Response (DFIR), Evidence Collection, Malware Analysis, Threat Hunting, and Root Cause Analysis. Role Purpose and Focus The primary objective of this role is to identify, contain, eradicate, and recover from security incidents while preserving forensic integrity. The analyst will contribute to strengthening the organization's overall security posture by conducting thorough investigations and analysis of various cyber threats. This is a project-based role requiring a proactive approach to incident management. Key Responsibilities Investigate cybersecurity incidents through Incident Investigation, Host Analysis, Network Analysis, and Breach Analysis across endpoints, servers, cloud environments, and enterprise networks. Lead or support incident response activities throughout the incident lifecycle, including identification, triage, threat containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident analysis. Perform Evidence Collection, Artifact Collection, Forensic Imaging, and Disk Imaging while maintaining Chain of Custody and forensic integrity. Conduct Memory Analysis and Memory Dump Analysis to identify malicious activity, persistence mechanisms, and attacker techniques. Perform Disk Forensics, Windows Forensics, Linux Forensics, and Network Forensics to determine the scope and impact of security incidents. Investigate malware, ransomware, phishing attacks, insider threats, account compromise, and other advanced cyber threats through Malware Analysis and Malware Triage. Perform Root Cause Analysis, Timeline Analysis, and Timeline Creation to reconstruct attack activity and determine attack vectors. Identify, analyze, and extract Indicators of Compromise (IOC Analysis and IOC Extraction), Indicators of Attack (IOAs), and adversary Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures (TTPs) to support incident investigations and Threat Hunting activities. Utilize forensic and investigation tools such as Volatility, Autopsy, FTK, EnCase, SIEM platforms, and Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR/XDR) solutions. Perform Log Analysis across operating systems, applications, security devices, and cloud platforms to identify malicious activity and support forensic investigations. Coordinate with SOC, Threat Intelligence, IT Infrastructure, Cloud Operations, and other stakeholders during incident investigations and response activities. Develop comprehensive Case Documentation, investigation reports, executive summaries, forensic findings, technical timelines, and remediation recommendations. Maintain and improve incident response playbooks, forensic procedures, investigation methodologies, and digital evidence handling processes. Contribute to the continuous improvement of the organization's Digital Forensics, Incident Response (DFIR), Threat Hunting, and cyber incident response capabilities. Experience and Qualifications Candidates should possess 2-5 years of experience in a relevant field. Specific qualifications were not provided, but a strong background in the responsibilities listed above is expected. Work Environment This is a full-time, project-based position located in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role involves collaboration with various internal teams and stakeholders to ensure effective incident response and security posture improvement. c69efa0385d27e49.description: Cohorts: January & June (Yearly) | Function: Multiple, apply once and tell us where you want to build About us: Tamara is Saudi Arabia's first FinTech unicorn, on a mission to help people own their dreams by building the most customer-centric financial super app in the world. There's no playbook for that; our Tamarians are writing it as we go, and we believe potential should be stretched early. The Internship Program is built for students who don't want to sit on the sidelines. Our internships welcome undergraduate and postgraduate students alike (Master's, MBA, or PhD), and if you're hungry to apply what you've learned in a fast-moving, high-performance environment, this is where you begin. We treat our interns and co-ops as future builders, because in many ways, they already are. This year, we're keeping things simple: one application gets you into the running for any area you're interested in. Just share a bit about yourself, highlight what you're great at, and tell us which teams get you excited. We want you to work on what you're passionate about, so we'll look at your interests to match you with a role where you can jump in and start building. Where You Could Build: Product : Get hands-on with how a fintech unicorn builds products people actually love. You'll support Product Managers in shaping features used by millions of shoppers, drawing on data and customer insight to explore areas for improvement, conceptualise new products, and dive into a wide range of financial services, from personal banking to brand new fintech solutions. Engineering: Write code that ships. As part of our engineering team, you'll work alongside senior engineers on live projects, from feature builds to system improvements, gaining mentorship and real production experience from day one. Design: Help design the experiences behind a product millions of people trust with their money. You'll contribute to real flows and interfaces, working closely with Product and Engineering to build seamless fintech solutions. You will dive directly into uncovering user needs, mapping out core user journeys, and rapidly iterating through wireframes. Data: Get hands-on with the numbers behind millions of transactions. You'll support analytics and reporting that help teams understand customers, measure impact, and make better decisions. Commercial: Our Commercial teams cover two sides of the same goal: Sales, where you'll help find, pitch, and sign new merchant partners, and Account Management, where you'll help look after existing partners and grow those relationships over time. Marketing: Get hands-on with how a fintech unicorn tells its story. You'll support brand, growth, and campaign work that reaches customers and merchants across the region. Finance & Accounting: Get inside the financial engine of a unicorn. You'll support month-end close, financial reporting, and audits, learning what it takes to keep a fast-scaling company's numbers accurate and controlled. Strategy: Work close to the top. You'll contribute to market research, competitor benchmarking, and strategic projects that inform decisions made by Tamara's executive team: real exposure to strategic thinking at the highest level. Note: The functions listed above aren't an exhaustive list. If you're interested in an area we haven't mentioned here, tell us on your application; we still want to hear from you. What We Look For: Experience Currently pursuing a Bachelor's, Master's,MBA or PHD in a relevant field, we welcome applications from both undergraduate and postgraduate students Passionate about continuous iteration and bringing a creative mindset to solving problems, no matter the function. Prior Internship, Co-op, or project experience relevant to your area of interest is a plus, but not required; we care more about your curiosity and drive than a packed CV Skills Strong analytical and problem-solving instincts Clear communication, written and verbal Good organisational skills: able to prioritise and manage your workload independently Comfortable with Google Workspace / basic tools of your field; anything more specialised (like coding languages or CRM tools) is a bonus, not a requirement Attributes Curious, driven, and genuinely excited to build, not just observe A self-starter who takes initiative rather than waiting for instructions Resilient and adaptable, thriving in a fast-paced, sometimes ambiguous environment A collaborative team player who leads with empathy and respect Eager to learn and grow, with the energy to match a high-performance environment Why Tamara? Our teams are made up of innovators, problem-solvers, and learners. We thrive on curiosity and collaboration. If this sounds like you: curious, driven, and ready to build, we'd love to meet you. Apply now and join the next generation of Builders. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. To learn more about how we protect your privacy, please visit our Candidate Privacy Notice .

c62696966107bf0a.description: About Unifonic and the Role Unifonic, recognized as a Great Place to Work®, is an AI-native customer experience platform serving over 5,000 enterprises across MENA. The company specializes in conversational AI and is developing sovereign, agentic AI through its Agentic Studio platform. This part-time role for an Arabic Linguist is based in Riyadh, Riyadh Province, and involves supporting the Text-to-Speech (TTS) team with linguistic analysis and Arabic dialect expertise. Role Overview As an Arabic Linguist, you will contribute linguistic expertise to real production projects within the AI and TTS team. Your work will focus on improving the quality, accuracy, and naturalness of Arabic speech technology. The role requires strong expertise in Saudi Arabic dialects, with a preference for native or near-native proficiency in the Najdi dialect. Key Responsibilities Conduct research on the phonological, morphological, and syntactic structures of Arabic, focusing on Modern Standard Arabic (MSA) and Saudi/Gulf dialects, particularly Najdi, and provide linguistic guidance for their integration into Sestek products. Serve as a linguistic point of contact for the R&D / AI team, translating linguistic requirements into actionable input for engineers. Analyze and review pronunciation data, including grapheme-to-phoneme mappings, diacritization/tashkeel, and lexicons, for Arabic TTS and speech recognition systems. Evaluate TTS output quality for pronunciation accuracy, prosody, dialect authenticity, and naturalness, with a focus on Saudi Arabic. Provide linguistic guidance and support for Arabic voice data collection and speech synthesis projects, including identifying and onboarding suitable voice talents. Support the coordination and review of voice recording and editing processes to ensure linguistic accuracy and consistency. Assist in onboarding and coordinating external Arabic language consultants, providing guidance on linguistic requirements. Review and provide linguistic feedback on data annotation activities and guidelines, ensuring quality standards for Arabic and Saudi dialect data. Collaborate with the Sestek TTS and AI Research teams, offering ongoing linguistic expertise throughout projects. Qualifications and Requirements Bachelor's degree in Linguistics, Arabic Language and Literature, Translation and Interpreting, or a related field. Native proficiency in Arabic, with a strong command of MSA and Saudi Arabic dialects. Native or near-native proficiency in the Najdi dialect is strongly preferred. Familiarity with Arabic dialects beyond Saudi Arabic is preferred. Strong knowledge of Arabic phonology and morphology, and familiarity with the International Phonetic Alphabet (IPA). Good command of English, as it will be the working language with the R&D / AI team. Strong communication skills and comfort working with technical, non-linguist colleagues. Familiarity with speech technologies (TTS/ASR), voice data collection, or NLP is a plus. Experience working with Saudi Arabic dialects, particularly the Najdi dialect, is highly preferred. Ability to work on a part-time basis and collaborate remotely with teams based in Türkiye and Saudi Arabia. Work Environment This is a part-time position that involves remote collaboration with teams located in Türkiye and Saudi Arabia. The role is based in Riyadh, within the Riyadh Province.
